landing.title: Reports
landing.subtitle: Turn your numbers into a report you can take into a meeting — charts, recommendations, and where every figure came from.
landing.yourReportsSubtitle: Saved report definitions shared across this workspace.
landing.startSubtitle: Pick a template and Connex builds the report from your data in seconds.
landing.firstSubtitle: Choose a template below. Connex turns your workspace data into a narrative business report with charts, an appendix, and traceable sources.
landing.deleteDetails: Its frozen snapshots go with it.

composer.title: Describe the report you need
composer.subtitle: Ask in plain language. Connex shows you the report it would build before saving anything.
composer.grounding: This step just sets up what the report covers. The numbers come when you run it.
composer.requestLabel: What should this report help you understand?
composer.placeholder: Show monthly pipeline health, at-risk revenue, and single-threaded deals grouped by stage.
composer.requestHint: Leave out names, email addresses, and other personal details.
composer.generatedDescription: Here is the report Connex would build.
composer.scopeValue: This workspace, and only the records you can see.

assumption.current_owners: Counts each record for whoever owns it today.
assumption.server_computed_figures: The numbers are worked out when the report runs.
assumption.date_range_inferred: Dates come from how often the report runs.

composer.freshness: Set up {date}. No numbers yet — run the report to see them.

unavailable.not_configured: AI is turned off here. Use a template, or build the report yourself.
unavailable.input_restricted: Your request has details Connex won't send to the AI. Take out anything personal and try again.
unavailable.rate_limited: You've hit the AI limit for now. Try again later, or build the report yourself.
unavailable.invalid_definition: Connex couldn't turn that into a report. Try saying it a different way, or build it yourself.
unavailable.provider_error: The AI couldn't draft this. Try again, or build the report yourself.

builder.subtitle: Pick what goes in, arrange it, and Connex writes the summary from the numbers.
builder.name: Name
builder.descriptionPlaceholder: What should this report help the team decide?
builder.filtersSubtitle: A filter only applies to the sections it makes sense for.
builder.attainmentFilters: Quota attainment always covers the whole target, so pipeline, status, and tag filters don't apply. You can filter by owner only if the report has no workspace-wide attainment section.
builder.ownersLoadError: Workspace members could not be loaded. Retry to manage owner filters.
builder.ownersLoadBlocked: Couldn't load members. Clear the unavailable owners, or try again before saving.
builder.ownersUnavailable: Remove unavailable members from the owner filter before saving.
builder.canvasSubtitle: Drag to reorder, and set how wide each section is. These previews are samples — the real numbers appear when you run the report.
builder.nameRequired: Give the report a name before saving.
builder.rangeRequired: Custom reports require both a start and end date.
builder.dragInstructions: Press space to lift a section, arrow keys to move it, and space again to drop it.

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Set monthly or quarterly won-revenue targets for individual owners or the entire workspace.

goals.deleteDetails: This is the revenue target for {scope}.
